title: The line bundle of an effective Cartier divisor is invertible
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_S$ be an effective Cartier ideal [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal] (a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf which, on the members of some open cover of $S$, is generated by a single nonzerodivisor of the ring of sections), i.e. the ideal sheaf $\mathcal I_D$ of the effective Cartier divisor $D=V(\mathcal I)\subset S$. Then the dual $\mathcal I^\vee=\mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal O_S}(\mathcal I,\mathcal O_S)$, which is the module $\mathcal O_S(D)$ of [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle], is an invertible $\mathcal O_S$-module [def-sc-invertible-module].
